prompt: Accu must match the attached image identity: visibly young adult human woman, warm tan skin, green eyes, blunt black bangs, clipped sides, long black twin ponytails with teal ties, black sleeveless athletic uniform with teal/violet trim, black sleeves and tights, teal/violet sneakers. Draw EXACTLY ten right-facing full-body CELEBRATION animation poses, five columns × two rows, row-major; ten frames total, one in each grid cell. Preserve same identity, body and two-arm/two-leg anatomy in all ten. Uniform blank, no number/text/logo. Sequence: 0 calm ready, 1 smiles and raises one fist at chest, 2 pumps both fists, 3 upbeat bounce with elbows raised, 4 confident fist pump at simulation tick 5, 5 lands from bounce with arms up, 6 celebrates with open arms, 7 gives a short victory wave, 8 lowers arms with a grin, 9 settles back into ready. Empty hands. Separate game ball MUST NOT be drawn. No ball, other athlete, court, hoop, background, floor, shadow, effects, letters or symbols. True transparent RGBA background, not a checkerboard or matte; crisp outlined 1990s arcade pixel art. No crop of hair, hands or feet.

cleanup.method: remove edge-connected neutral checker pixels and add six transparent top/bottom safe-margin pixels
